headers.//: The admin dashboard was framable, so a page elsewhere could overlay it and harvest clicks from a signed-in admin. Nothing on this site is meant to be embedded.
Nothing here uses a camera, a microphone or location.
frame-ancestors repeats X-Frame-Options for browsers that prefer CSP. connect-src has to name the Worker, which is a different origin from the site.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://events.oscvitap.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: Subdomains included so events.oscvitap.com is covered too.
Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a given URL's bytes never change. Without this they were revalidated on every page load.
